mapper.sql: ei.item_id as "itemId", ei.area_id as "areaId", ea.rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", erv.version_code as "versionCode", erv.version_status as "versionStatus", ea.area_code as "areaCode", ea.area_name as "areaName", ei.item_code as "itemCode", ei.item_name as "itemName", ei.parent_item_code as "parentItemCode", ei.sort_order as "sortOrder", ei.active_yn as "activeYn", ei.score_apply_method as "scoreApplyMethod", ei.change_reason as "changeReason", ei.updated_by as "updatedBy", ei.updated_at as "updatedAt"

where.if: and (ei.item_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ei.item_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ea.area_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ea.area_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
select from evaluation_items ei inner join evaluation_areas ea on ea.area_id = ei.area_id inner join evaluation_rule_versions erv on erv.rule_version_id = ea.rule_version_id
order by ea.sort_order, ea.area_code, ei.sort_order, ei.item_code limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
select count(*) from evaluation_items ei inner join evaluation_areas ea on ea.area_id = ei.area_id inner join evaluation_rule_versions erv on erv.rule_version_id = ea.rule_version_id
mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_items (area_id, item_code, item_name, parent_item_code, sort_order, active_yn, score_apply_method, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{areaId}, #{request.itemCode}, #{request.itemName}, #{request.parentItemCode}, #{request.sortOrder}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.scoreApplyMethod}, #{request.changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (area_id, item_code) do update set item_name = EXCLUDED.item_name, parent_item_code = EXCLUDED.parent_item_code, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, active_yn = EXCLUDED.active_yn, score_apply_method = EXCLUDED.score_apply_method, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId})
